text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and latency observed for Hosted API + Dedicated pools in sa-east-1. Error rate spike ~4.3% p95 latency 2.1s -> 6.4s. Initial detection at 2025-06-05T14:13:09Z. Pager sent.

oncall-bot: Paging @leo_sre, @shaun_platform — SRE oncall

leo_sre: taking this. starting quick triage, checking health & logs

leo_sre: run: curl -I https://api.redwood.example/health

leo_sre: response: HTTP/2 503 Service Unavailable (from edge LB)

shaun_platform: seeing target group unhealthy counts rising on sa-east-1 NLB. Backend instances healthy but LB returning 503/504s. Possible upstream AWS network issue.

maria_prod: customer impact: error rate visible in dashboards + direct reports: fintech-beta and analytics-suite seeing elevated 503s and slow tokenization. Estimated ~2-6% of requests affected based on regional routing split.

alex_support: prepping customer comms. Draft: "We're aware of increased errors and latency in Brazil (sa-east-1). We're routing traffic to alternate regions and will update shortly." Will post once status page draft approved.

leo_sre: mitigation steps: 1) temporarily failover regional routing for hosted API from sa-east-1 -> us-east-1 2) enable model-variant fallback for enterprise tenants pinned to sa-east-1 3) increase retries with exponential backoff in edge proxy for 503s

leo_sre: internal cmd: redwoodctl route update --region sa-east-1 --fallback us-east-1 --apply

devops-bot: NOTE: route update accepted. Applying change now. New routing rule will start in ~30s.

devops-bot: done. New requests from sa-east-1 are now routed to us-east-1 (non-destructive). Rolling window: 0-5m.

shaun_platform: Dedicated pools: initiating cold-start of additional capacity in us-east-1 and spinning up small quantized variants to absorb burst. Scaling triggered: +6 nodes.

maria_prod: posted initial statuspage: "Investigating increased error rates for South America region; traffic is being routed to alternate regions. We will update as we know more."

alex_support: posted to affected customers and internal #customer-notifications with template. Reactions: :thumbsup:

leo_sre: watching error rate drop. p95 down from 6.4s -> 1.2s after routing. 5xx ~4.3% -> 0.5% (still elevated). Leaving watch for 30m.

leo_sre: cross-checked AWS status: multiple reports for NLB/edge connectivity in sa-east-1. Filing support case with AWS: case# 12345678

maria_prod: estimating customer impact window ~14:13 -> 14:40 UTC; will prepare timeline for postmortem.

leo_sre: handing off to @shaun_platform for follow-up and long-running remediation. I need to step off for a code review but will remain reachable.

shaun_platform: taking over. I'll continue monitoring infra, follow AWS case, and coordinate rollback once AWS confirms stability. Starting RCA doc in #postmortems.

devops-bot: AWS support updated: "We're investigating a networking issue impacting NLB traffic in sa-east-1" — will post updates as provided.

alex_support: customers notified of routing mitigation and ETA for full recovery 90m. Escalation channels open.

shaun_platform: logged actions and will collect logs/metrics for postmortem. Proposed follow-ups: 1) add automatic cross-region fallback for regional LB health anomalies 2) polishing runbook for sa-east-1 NLB issues 3) cost vs SLA review for cross-region bursts.

incident-bot: Alert cleared: regional 5xx/latency anomalies returned to baseline after routing and capacity changes. Monitoring will watch for 2 hours. Incident classified: partial regional degradation — sa-east-1 — caused by cloud-provided load balancer connectivity. Postmortem scheduled.

shaun_platform: closing thread here. Will attach timeline + logs to postmortem doc and tag product/support. Thanks all.
